done_when: forge sync installs a remote-approval skill for Claude Code that starts a plainly named claude remote-control session in a chosen checkout, and doctor's drift check covers it

findings.body: The tests cover installation and drift, but none protects the launch behavior required by Done-when. In tests/test_setup.py:105–107, the sync test checks paths and write messages; lines 120–125 check idempotence. The doctor case checks changed content against the same template. Removing `cd <checkout>`, `remote-control`, `--name`, or the plain-English naming instructions from the template would leave these tests passing. Add an independent contract test against the installed skill that fails when those required instructions break.
findings.title: Not done: test the installed skill's named launch in the chosen checkout

why: Owners away from the laptop can't act in a session that needs another checkout's hooks
